Register Field Explanation: Wakeup Event Enable On SD Card Removal - This bit enables wakeup event via Card Removal assertion in the Normal Interrupt Status register. FN_WUS (Wake Up Support) in CIS does not affect this bit. 1=Enable, 0=Disable

Wakeup Event Enable On SD Card Insertion - This bit enables wakeup event via Card Insertion assertion in the Normal Interrupt Status register. FN_WUS (Wake Up Support) in CIS does not affect this bit. 1=Enable, 0=Disable

Wakeup Event Enable On Card Interrupt - This bit enables wakeup event via Card Interrupt assertion in the Normal Interrupt Status register. This bit can be set to 1 if FN_WUS (Wake Up Support) in CIS is set to 1. 1=Enable, 0=Disable
